name: apply_round_gate
meaning: cmp rdx,rsi: block round against parent round

name: apply_parent_gate
meaning: cmp rdi,rsi: Context round against parent round

name: apply_chain_gate
meaning: cmp byte [rbx+0x8f2],3: this build applies chain 3 only

name: apply_frozen_word
meaning: cmp dword [rbx+0x3ae8],2: flag handed to begin_block

name: begin_prev_time
meaning: mov [rbx+0x74],edi: old time goes to prev_time

name: begin_tx_none
meaning: mov qword [rbx],0: tx_index None during the block step

name: third_mirror_height
meaning: mov [rbx+0x1018],rdi: third copy keeps height in a second place

name: third_mirror_time
meaning: mov [rbx+0x1020],rcx: third copy keeps the block time there

name: freeze_lower_only
meaning: cmp rdx,rcx: a set height can only move down

name: freeze_span_guard
meaning: cmp rcx,-50000: overflow branch of the window

name: vote_limit
meaning: mov rax,0x0ccccccccccccccc: limit on the vote value before the gate

name: host_context_copy
meaning: movups [rbx+0x10],xmm1: Context words copied out of the Exchange at rbx+0x88

name: host_equal
meaning: jne: only freeze_height == height goes on

name: reload_height
meaning: cmp rax,r12: file height against the wanted height

name: tick_due
meaning: cmp r12,rax: round against last key plus period
